key_points: 现在进行时：They are playing / The birds are flying
过去时回顾：I ran / I danced / I had fun
原因从句 because（首次出现）

timeline.title: 开场问候 · 过去时回顾
timeline.detail: How are you? → I ran at the park / I danced at home / I had fun today

timeline.title: 新单元导入 · 看图描述
timeline.detail: We begin a new unit today。看图：I see a family and a ball / They are in the park

timeline.title: 看图提问 · 现在进行时
timeline.detail: What game are they playing? → They are playing football（先答 They play，老师引导补充 are）

timeline.title: 运动分类 · 喜好表达
timeline.detail: I like to play basketball / I play basketball in the park

timeline.title: 家庭概念 · children/adults/parents
timeline.detail: The boy and girl are children → mom and dad are adults → 统称 parents

timeline.title: 鸟类 · wings to fly
timeline.detail: Birds use wings to fly / They fly in the sky / Dogs can't fly

timeline.title: 蜜蜂谜语 · bee
timeline.detail: I don't like to eat honey because it is too sweet（首次完整使用 because）

timeline.title: 能力表达 · can/can't
timeline.detail: I can draw / walk / skate / run / jump

timeline.title: 天空与云 · 颜色
timeline.detail: The sky is blue / The clouds are white / clouds are black（雨天）

timeline.title: 水的用途
timeline.detail: drink / swim / take a shower / wash our face and hands

timeline.title: 游泳场景 · goggles
timeline.detail: This boy is swimming / swimming pool / goggles（泳镜）/ I am scared of water

timeline.title: 公园跑步 · 总结告别
timeline.detail: The boy and girl are running / I run with my friends

strengths: 过去时掌握优秀：I ran / I danced / I had fun 回答流畅
现在进行时大幅进步，能在引导下补充 are
首次完整使用 because 从句：because it is too sweet
水的用途四项全部答出
weaknesses: can/can't 否定句不稳定，需要巩固
复数主语忘记 are，单独说 They play 而非 They are playing
游泳场所混淆 sea 与 swimming pool
performance.teacher_comment: Mera 本节课表现活跃，互动积极，语言输出量大。老师善用追问技巧引导更完整表达，对错误给予及时温和纠正。

mastered: 家庭成员词汇（dad / mom / brother / sister / parents）
water 用途词汇（drink / swim / shower）
needs_review: 现在进行时 are + V-ing（容易漏掉 are）
because 从句（首次出现，需巩固）
复数名词 clouds（容易写成单数）

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: Did you have a good day? What did you do today?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: I ran with my mom at the park.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: What sports do you like to play?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.correction: That's a game, not a sport. I like to play basketball.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: What do birds use to fly?

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: Do you like to eat honey?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: No, I don't like to eat honey because it is too sweet.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: What color are the clouds when it rains?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.text: He is swimming in the sea.
dialogue.correction: He is swimming in the swimming pool.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text: What are the boy and girl doing?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.correction: The boy and girl are running.

vocab_fill.question: The boy is swimming in the swimming _____.

sentence_making.prompt: 用现在进行时描述：birds / fly / sky
sentence_making.example_answer: The birds are flying in the sky.

sentence_making.prompt: 用 because 说明原因：not like swimming / scared of water
sentence_making.example_answer: I don't like swimming because I am scared of water.
We use water to drink / take a shower / wash our hands.

qa_practice.question: What do birds use to fly?
What can you do with water?
qa_practice.answer: We can drink water, swim, take a shower and wash our face and hands.

qa_practice.question: Who are the adults in a family?
qa_practice.answer: Mom and dad are the adults. They are also called parents.
